07d093d0: ;
 .;Health Factor Edit Module
 .;
 .;This routine is a component of the Auto Remittance Advice Messaging
 .;option of the Enrollment Application System (Version 5.0).
 .;The module allows health factors on the EnrollmentSystem
 .;Health Factor file (#393) to be edited. For each patient, only the
 .;most recent health factor occurrence (date of occurrence) for a
 .;given health factor category can be true (status = "TRUE").
 .;All other occurrences are automatically set to false ("FALSE" status).
